anomalies.observed: On the CM4 sheet, the ComputeModule4 symbol pins whose names are SD_VDD_Override and +5v(Input) are connected by net labels to the HDMI connector nets: pin 35 (SD_VDD_Override) carries NET0076, pin 36 (+5v Input) carries NET0057, pin 37 (+5v Input) carries NET0046, pins 38/39 (+5v Input) are tied to GND, and pin 40 (+5v Input) carries NET0205. The same NET0076/NET0057/NET0046/NET0205 labels appear on the J13 HDMI connector pins for D2+, SCL, SDA, and utility/HEAC+.
anomalies.expected: The CM4 +5V input pins should be connected to the +5V power rail, not to HDMI signal nets or GND, and SD_VDD_Override should not be tied to HDMI D2+. The HDMI SCL/SDA lines should connect to the CM4 I2C pins (Module2A pins 78/79 in this drawing), not to the +5V input pins.

evidence.quote: CM4 sheet: Module2A pin 35 'SD_VDD_Override' -> NET0076; pin 36 '+5v(Input)' -> NET0057; pin 37 '+5v(Input)' -> NET0046; pins 38/39 '+5v(Input)' -> GND; pin 40 '+5v(Input)' -> NET0205.
CM4 sheet: J13 HDMI connector pin 1 'D2+' -> NET0076, pin 10 'SCL' -> NET0057, pin 11 'SDA' -> NET0046, pin 12/14 utility -> NET0205.
Power distribution: DC-DC conversion, a CM4 power-enable path (GLOBAL_EN), and USB input "OR-ing"/protection circuitry.

anomalies.impact: The CM4 +5V supply pins are not connected to the +5V rail and are instead shorted to HDMI signal nets and ground. This would prevent the CM4 from powering correctly and could damage or mis-bias the HDMI interface, while also leaving the HDMI I2C/EDID path disconnected from the CM4 I2C pins.

parsed.summary: The schematic shows a CM4 power/HDMI bridging error: the Module2A +5V input pins and SD_VDD_Override pin are labeled with HDMI connector nets (NET0076/NET0057/NET0046/NET0205) and GND instead of being connected to the +5V rail and appropriate CM4 signal pins.
